messages:
Maya: Quick alert — Cascade onboarding hit repeated p99 latency regressions on /generate this morning (~1.1s baseline -> ~2.9s peaks). I recommend a short pilot: INT8 quantized model-x-1 for throughput wins + route <=64 token requests to model-x-small. Tagging @Ciara @Nathan for ops.
Ciara: Sounds good. Can run. Need sample of request lengths and a preferred cutover time from the customer. :point_up:
Maya: Sample buckets for last 24h: <=64 tokens: 61.8%, 65-256: 27.9%, >256: 10.3%. Proposing route predicate: request.prompt_tokens <= 64 && client.handle == "cascade" && client.tier == "latency".
Nathan: INT8 on model-x-1 typically saves ~20-30% per-token latency on our A100 fleet. Small expected eval hit (~1-2% accuracy on our internal suite). I'll prepare a focused eval set to measure.
Liam: Routing plan: preference to model-x-small for short requests and traffic bursts; keep model-x-1 as default for long prompts. Canary 10% for 48h, auto-fallback to model-x-1 on errors >0.5% or quality drift above threshold.
Ashley-CS: Cascade approved a 10% canary starting tomorrow 09:00 PST. They asked for daily updates and a short summary at the end. This is urgent — they mentioned renewal sensitivity if perf not improved within 2 weeks.
Ciara: I'll create the canary config, include p95/p99 dashboards, and set alerts. Also will record end-to-end latency and routing distribution.
Nathan: Pushing quant artifacts to refs/heads/cascade/quant-pilot and will include regression tests + thresholds in the PR description.
deploy-bot: Canary initiated for cascade-prod at 3032110001; policy={"percent":10,"duration":"48h","target":"model-x-small","fallback":"model-x-1"}
Liam: I'll instrument traces to capture token-level latency, cache hit rates, and KV cache warmup behavior. Watching for any uptick in retries.
Ciara: Plan to post a 24h interim snapshot in this thread (latency deltas, routing split, eval pass/fail). If things look good we roll to 50% for 24h then full.
Maya: I'll update CRM to mark Cascade as "onboarding: perf pilot" and flag renewal risk as "medium" until pilot completes. If pilot meets p99 <1.5s target for latency-tiered traffic, we reduce risk to low. Thanks team :handshake:
Ashley-CS: Please include a short customer-facing note we can share with their engineering lead after 24h.
Ciara: Will draft a 3-line customer update with metrics and next steps for review before posting.
Nathan: Noted — I'll attach the eval artifact and a plain-English note about expected QA regression.
Maya: Great. Logging this thread and will follow up after the 24h checkpoint. :rocket:
